# `senate_disbursement_pages`

**Senate disbursement page coverage**

Every physical page of the selected original reports, including unread image and summary content and pages yielding no payments.

**Coverage.** Window. Every physical page of each PDF in the same selected scope as senate_disbursements. Page visitation does not establish complete financial interpretation of other grids or images. *(measured 2026-11-06)*

**Data quality.** Native text can omit image content. A ledger_read outcome describes only the recognized ledger; native summaries outside it remain visible in native_text and the original reading. Empty ledger output is not proof of an empty report. Unassigned lines and image counts remain separate from successful monetary records.

- **Parquet file:** `senate_disbursement_pages.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
